outcome: Rate of vaginal delivery within 48 hours
cohort: Pregnant women with a Bishop score < 7 undergoing labor induction
finding: Dinoprostone vaginal insert was more effective for labor induction than the double-balloon catheter, with a higher rate of vaginal delivery within 48 hours and lower cesarean section rate.
mod_finding: The rate of vaginal delivery within 48 h was significantly higher in the Dinoprostone group than that in the double-balloon catheter group.
